detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Scan for packages containing heavily obfuscated Python code, especially in __init__.py, with dynamic exec/eval usage. Flag self-referential file checks and process termination logic based on copyright or anti-tampering strings. Monitor for credential access, screenshot capture, and outbound network connections to unknown domains. Use static analysis to detect obfuscation markers and dynamic analysis to observe anti-tampering and exfiltration behaviors.
